items.title: 'The Challenge' Star Tyler Duckworth's Cause of Death Revealed
items.summary:
The Challenge star Tyler Duckworth ’s cause of death has been revealed.

The North Dakota State Forensic Examiner’s Office confirmed to Us  on Friday, November 27, that Tyler died of hypertensive cardiovascular disease. His manner of death was ruled natural.

The Cleveland Clinic states that hypertensive heart disease can cause problems because of long-term, unmanaged high blood pressure. The added strain on one’s heart can lead to heart failure. ( TMZ was first to report the news.)

News broke on August 13 that Tyler had died at the age of 44.

‘The Challenge’ Stars React to Tyler Duckworth’s Death at Age 44 

“My son, Tyler, passed away earlier this week,” Tyler’s mom, Jodi Duckworth , wrote via Facebook at the time. “Cause of death has yet to be determined. I will post on Facebook about services as soon as his dad and I figure it out.”

The Grand Forks Police Department later confirmed to Us that its officers had responded to a welfare check on August 11. When they arrived, Tyler was found unresponsive and determined to be deceased.

Tyler Duckworth Courtesy of The Challenge/Instagram 
 Tyler’s death came nearly two weeks after he appeared at The Challenge Mania event in Minneapolis. In his final social media post before his death, the reality star expressed how excited he was to interact with fans and meet with fellow competitors, including Paulie Calafiore , Mark Long and Rachel Robinson .

“So proud to represent my hometown of Minneapolis along with these other Challenge legends,” Tyler wrote via Instagram on August 2. “The fans are what keep us coming out! Hearing…
items.t: 'The Challenge' Star Tyler Duckworth's Cause of Death Revealed

items.title: What Did Karen Read Do for Work? Her Jobs Before 2 Murder Trials
items.summary:
Before her name became attached to one of the most closely watched murder cases in Massachusetts history, Karen Read had a career in finance. She worked as a financial analyst and served as an adjunct professor of finance at Bentley University, teaching students in the Boston-area business school while building a professional life far outside the courtroom.

That quiet career was upended in early 2022, when Read was accused of second-degree murder and manslaughter in the death of her boyfriend, Boston police officer John O’Keefe . What followed were two trials, a hung jury, an acquittal on the most serious charges and — most recently — a civil lawsuit against the two police agencies that investigated her.

Here is what Us knows about Read, her background and the legal fight she says is far from over.

Karen Read’s Career Before the Murder Trials 
 Read previously worked as a financial analyst and an adjunct professor of finance at Bentley University. Her life in finance and academia drew little public attention until she became the central figure in the investigation into O’Keefe’s death.

She has not publicly discussed returning to that work since her acquittal. Instead, Read has shifted her focus to a civil case she says is about accountability, not a payout.

Terry Kanmacher has been arrested after he allegedly stabbed Lauren Becker to death. Kenmacher, 21, was caught while trying to board a plane at a Minnesota airport to head home to his native country of France.

Omaha Police Chief Todd Schmaderer said during a press conference that Kanmacher allegedly attacked Becker, 22, outside Kids Can Community Center in Omaha on Tuesday, November 24, around 9:15 a.m.

Kanmacher arrived in Omaha on Sunday, November 22. Schmaderer said Kanmacher left his Airbnb two days later and waited in the childcare center’s parking lot for about 45 minutes before attacking Becker as she walked to work.

Becker and Kanmacher previously connected online, and they met only one time in prison when he flew to Omaha in the summer of 2023. Becker ended their communication in December 2023 and reportedly made it clear she did not see a future with him.

“The victim was very clear in 2023 that the relationship was over,” Schmaderer said, per Nebraska Public Media . “She was afraid of him at this point. She came to the police department and she reported her concerns. Her concerns were very detail oriented, and a lot of her concerns mirrored what took place, quite frankly.”

Three years later, Kanmacher allegedly traveled to Omaha with plans to kill Becker.
